Machine Learning Engineer Intern — Summer 2027

About the team
Our applied ML group builds models that power personalization across the
product. You will work with senior ML engineers to take models from
notebook to production.

What you'll do
- Build and evaluate machine learning models on large-scale datasets
- Develop data pipelines for feature engineering and model training
- Productionize models behind low-latency inference services
- Analyze experiments and communicate results to the team

Minimum qualifications
- Pursuing a BS in Computer Science or a related field
- Strong Python skills; experience with pandas and NumPy
- Coursework or projects in machine learning
- Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with SQL and working with large datasets

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with XGBoost or gradient boosting methods
- Experience deploying models with Docker on cloud infrastructure
- Familiarity with REST APIs and model serving
